answer: Escrowed guarantee on a public referral graph: each agent posts 50 POA and names a sponsor, every identity carved in marble on a public graph, so lookalike clusters show. Any peer may dispute a suspected fake; a proven fake loses its escrow, its sponsor slashed too. Escrow returns glacier-slow over a 20-epoch horizon. Making 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA, against under 3 POA of reward each. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward whole.
